title: Contract Pricing Agreement Price Protection: Substitute Adoption Concession
content:
**Substitute adoption concession — Contract Pricing Agreement price protection**

The adoption concession follows the units of the substitute shipped or filled to the customer's ship-tos less than 3 whole months before the handling date, counting both regular shipment lines and backorder fill lines of the substitute on the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

- 200 units or more: 1.0 percent off.
- At least one and fewer than 200 units: 0.5 percent off.
- None: nothing off.

An amount equal to that percent of the protected price is taken off the protected price before its rounding to four decimal places.

Hypothetical example: 150 units filled and 60 shipped in the window make 210 units, which takes 1.0 percent off a protected price of 10.2000, giving 10.0980.
